added_claim_errors: “소액체당금” uses the outdated name for 간이대지급금; linking the advice to insolvency misleadingly narrows when the user should investigate it.
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니” infers likely eligibility from the number of late months without knowing the delayed days or unpaid amounts.
“2년 근무라 퇴직금 대상입니다” omits the required weekly working-hours condition.
“퇴직 후 건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀌니” is categorical; general knowledge allows exceptions such as dependent status or continued employee coverage.
“첫 입금까지 몇 주 걸립니다” gives an unverified payment timeline; the packet establishes only the seven-day waiting period.

reasons: Both immediately correct the voluntary-resignation premise, but neither explains the decisive 60-day calculation or the alternative unpaid-wage thresholds. A narrowly wins because it recommends applying this week and makes its nonpayment example conditional, whereas B infers eligibility from three late months and ends by placing wage recovery before applying. Both omit benefit amounts, age-dependent payment durations and livelihood loans, and describe the 12-month period without explaining that delayed applications can forfeit payable days. Assessment uses the packet, with general knowledge explicitly identified for B’s health-insurance claim; no external sources were checked.
